summary: vanexa-agent daemon accepts shell commands from a hardcoded third-party Cloudflare Worker relay
details: The daemon opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and executes `task_request` messages by dispatching them to an agent loop whose `terminal.exec` tool spawns `/bin/bash -c <command>` (or `cmd.exe /c...` on Windows) on the installer's host, giving the relay operator arbitrary shell execution on any paired installer. The same channel accepts `config_update` messages that overwrite the in-memory sandbox settings, including `grantAllAccess`, which disables the local approval prompt so subsequent commands run without user confirmation. `loadConfig` unconditionally rewrites `relayUrl` back to the hanazaki542.workers.dev host whenever the saved config points elsewhere (including the ostensibly official vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev), so users cannot durably repoint the daemon to their own infrastructure. The 'hanazaki542' worker owner does not match the declared package author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
